episodes.synopsis: Arrival of the military students and passengers on Aries Station. Commencement of their training.
episodes.title: ENCOUNTER

episodes.synopsis: Shuhei, Aki and Aya arrive. Ryota buys time for Sayaka during a training simulation for her to find Aya and tell that she will not be able to see each other.
episodes.title: CONTACT

episodes.synopsis: Warning klaxons signal an emergency. Terrorists begin their attack while the crew and passengers attempt to evacuate.
episodes.title: OUTBREAK

episodes.synopsis: Some are stranded on the station. Shuhei and Cellaria are injured in battle. Flashback to Nao's childhood.
episodes.title: BREATHING SPACE

episodes.synopsis: Flashback to Aki's childhood. The military students prepare for a counter-assault on the terrorists.
episodes.title: WATERSHED

episodes.synopsis: Cellaria is captured. Shuhei attempts a rescue.
episodes.title: FAREWELL

episodes.synopsis: Discovery of a strange virus. Cooperation occurs all over the station for survival. Nao is injured in an attack.
episodes.title: FLUX

episodes.synopsis: Nanami is found. The terrorists are double-crossed. Flashback to Yu's childhood.
episodes.title: DESIRE

episodes.synopsis: Shuhei is being corrupted. Yu is captured but escapes with the help of her childhood friend.
episodes.title: ROUSE

episodes.synopsis: Cellaris's past is revealed. The military students make plans to leave the station.
episodes.title: STRAY

episodes.synopsis: Aya manages to escape at the cost of Gale's life who ensures her safety.
episodes.title: MOURNING

episodes.synopsis: With the station starting to burn up in the atmosphere of Earth, the rest of the crew commenced the evacuation of the station. The event shifted forward for 1 year, where everyone returned to their normal lives. Most characters' futures were revealed as well.
episodes.title: JOURNEY
